posts.author: WolfradSenpai
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
In my game, I’d like to use images as maps. Right now I’m using
GALV_LayerGraphicsMZ
to do this, although I’m not sure it’s the best plugin for the job.
The main issue I’m having is that it’s hard to predict how to draw certain elements on the map and how to assign them a walkable or unwalkable tile. For now, I create a rough “sketch” of the map using the default RPG Maker MZ tileset >
save map as image
> and then draw over that file. But if I ever need to make changes later, it becomes very complicated to understand where and what to edit.
I remember that back in RPG Maker XP there was a plugin that allowed you to display an image directly in the map editor as a reference or something similiar (my memory is a little fuzzy). Does something like that exist for RPG Maker MZ? Or does anyone know of a plugin that could help?
Thanks!
(in case I wasn't clear, I meant something like this

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
the only way is to add the full image to it how it should look like.
replace later with the one you need so you can add collision correctly.
I don't know if there is a cleaner way to do this though or how XP handle it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
if you assign a picture as the parallax background, there is an option to show that in the editor.
that can only be used for a single picture, not multiple layers, but it should do for what you want.
